data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Evander was the founder of Pallantium, the ancient city of Palatine Hill in Rome. The name Evin carries the meaning “Life, giving” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Evin usually hope their child will grow to embody life, giving and live with faith, good character and purpose.
